description: The file defines the OrderEntity class, which extends the Order class and encapsulates order-related data such as totals, payment details, status, date, and currency within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderEntity
classes.description: A class representing an order with payment, status, and timestamp details, extending the core Order model.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of order totals.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves the list of order totals.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Returns the payment type used for the order.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type for the order.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Returns the credit card details used for payment.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setPreviousOrderStatus
methods.description: Sets the list of previous order statuses.

methods.name: getPreviousOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the list of previous order statuses.
